description: Pong: the ball moves, the paddle answers the keys, someone scores, and the ball never leaves the field.

checks.name: ball-stays-in-field
checks.expression: async () => { const p = window.pong; if (!p || !p.field) return false; const w = p.field.width, h = p.field.height; if (!(w > 0 && h > 0)) return false; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const b = window.pong.ball; if (!b) return false; if (b.x < 0 || b.x > w || b.y < 0 || b.y > h) return false; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); } return true; }
